fields.description:
Add a balanced standing evaluation corpus for T15 so its three-part applicability gate, required fast-proof behavior, and scoped-cleanup boundary remain measurable through the shipped prompt-eval seam.

## Work
- Add `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-T15.eval.yaml` using the packaged eval schema and the registered deterministic `no_fire_on_good_cases` and `recall_on_seeded_defects` scorers.
- Cover applicable/pass behavior for a new deployed service that names runtime-only boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks; commits to a concrete local or real-target manual proof that returns a verdict in minutes; performs that proof before codifying the slow loop; and scopes teardown to artifacts created by the experiment.
- Cover applicable/finding behavior when a similar deployed service relies only on its full slow delivery loop, and when destructive cleanup drops a pre-existing table or wipes a shared bucket.
- Cover not-applicable/pass behavior for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, and docs-only plans; health-route and mere "deploy" wording in application code; a fast/cheap pipeline that fails S2; and behavior whose correctness unit tests settle, which fails S3.
- Register the packaged spec in the shared strict-clean/balanced eval contract tests and add T15-specific assertions that pin the labeled case matrix.
- Add the app-only, library/CLI/docs, health-route, and incidental deploy cases to `observed-false-positives.md` as explicit T15 regression guards.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rebar prompt eval plan-review-T15` validates the packaged spec offline with strict-clean schema, registered deterministic scorers, a balanced pass/finding dataset, and a non-empty gold set.
- [ ] The dataset contains an applicable/pass deployed-service case naming boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks plus a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codification and cleanup limited to experiment-created artifacts.
- [ ] The dataset contains an applicable/finding deployed-service case whose only feedback is the full slow delivery loop.
- [ ] The dataset contains applicable/finding destructive-cleanup cases for dropping a pre-existing table and wiping a shared bucket.
- [ ] The dataset contains not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and incidental "deploy" application-code plans.
- [ ] The dataset contains not-applicable/pass S2 and S3 boundary cases for a fast/cheap pipeline and correctness settled by unit tests.
- [ ] Unit tests pin the expected T15 case identifiers, labels, scorer discipline, and packaged-spec validation through the public eval loader.
- [ ] `observed-false-positives.md` records the T15 application-scope negatives as regression guards.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar prompt eval plan-review-T15` to exercise the supported offline command.
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py tests/unit/test_t15_overlay_derisk_criterion.py -q` to prove packaged loading, scorer registration, balance, gold coverage, and the T15 case matrix.
- Run `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- Live semantic model evaluation is opt-in and nondeterministic per `README.plan-review.md`; this story ships the deterministic offline CI discipline and labeled standing corpus.
